title: Quentin and the Extraction
author: Xanthe Vasquez
blurb: Odile Crane, a financial-crimes investigator drowning in clean money, hasn't slept through the night since the incident. Then a dead handler sends a meeting invitation for tomorrow — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must extract a defector who may be the bait, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
